description.en: A digital SLR with a Nikon DX CCD sensor, an optical pentaprism viewfinder and an interchangeable Nikon F lens mount.
description.zh-cn: 一台采用尼康 DX 画幅 CCD 传感器的数码单反，配备五棱镜光学取景器，可更换尼康 F 卡口镜头。

en: CCD describes the sensor technology. DSLR describes the camera’s reflex viewing design. The D200 belongs to both categories.
While you frame a shot, a reflex mirror and pentaprism direct light from the taking lens to your eye. The finder gives you an optical view of the scene and the CCD captures light during exposure.
Nikon F names the connection between camera and lens. Check which lens functions the D200 supports and whether the lens covers its DX image area.
zh-cn: CCD 描述传感器技术，数码单反描述相机的反光取景结构。D200 同时符合这两种分类。
构图时，反光镜和五棱镜将拍摄镜头的光线引向眼睛，你在取景器里直接看到场景；曝光时，CCD 接收光线。
尼康 F 指机身和镜头之间的接口。选用镜头时，分别确认 D200 支持哪些镜头功能，以及镜头的成像范围能否覆盖 DX 画幅。
